mapper.sql: SELECT 1 FROM sys_portal_user portal_user JOIN crm_contact contact ON contact.tenant_id = portal_user.tenant_id AND contact.contact_id = portal_user.ref_biz_id AND contact.customer_id = portal_user.customer_id JOIN crm_customer customer ON customer.tenant_id = contact.tenant_id AND customer.customer_id = contact.customer_id JOIN sys_tenant tenant ON tenant.tenant_id = portal_user.tenant_id WHERE portal_user.tenant_id = #{identity.tenantId} AND portal_user.portal_user_id = #{identity.portalUserId} AND portal_user.customer_id = #{identity.customerId} AND portal_user.ref_biz_id = #{identity.contactId} AND portal_user.user_type = 'CUSTOMER_CONTACT' AND portal_user.ref_biz_type = 'CRM_CONTACT' AND portal_user.status = 'ACTIVE' AND portal_user.deleted = 0 AND portal_user.session_version = #{identity.sessionVersion} AND contact.version = #{identity.contactVersion} AND contact.status = 'ACTIVE' AND contact.deleted = 0 AND customer.status = 'ACTIVE' AND customer.deleted = 0 AND tenant.status = '0' AND tenant.deleted = 0 AND (tenant.expire_time IS NULL OR tenant.expire_time > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)

contract.deleted = 0 AND contract.customer_id IS NOT NULL AND contract.status IN ('APPROVED', 'SEALING', 'SEALED', 'ACTIVE', 'EXPIRED', 'TERMINATED') AND contract.signed_flag = 1 AND contract.our_signee_id > 0 AND contract.our_sign_time IS NOT NULL AND contract.our_sign_time <= #{now} AND contract.counterparty_sign_time IS NOT NULL AND contract.counterparty_sign_time <= #{now} AND contract.counterparty_signee REGEXP '[^[:space:]]' AND contract.signed_file_url REGEXP '[^[:space:]]' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM wf_process_instance approval WHERE approval.tenant_id = contract.tenant_id AND approval.instance_id = contract.instance_id AND approval.business_key = CONCAT('CONTRACT:', contract.contract_id) AND approval.process_def_key = 'biz_contract' AND approval.status IN ('PASSED', 'AUTO_PASSED') AND approval.deleted = 0 AND approval.end_time IS NOT NULL AND approval.end_time <= #{now})

contract.contract_id, contract.contract_no, contract.contract_name, contract.counterparty_name, CAST(contract.amount AS CHAR) AS amount, contract.currency, contract.start_date, contract.end_date, CASE WHEN contract.status IN ('ACTIVE', 'EXPIRED', 'TERMINATED') THEN contract.status ELSE 'SIGNED' END AS status

term.term_id, term.term_no, term.term_category, term.term_content, term.requirement, term.responsible_party, term.deadline_date, term.fulfilled_date, CASE WHEN term.waived_flag = 1 THEN 'WAIVED' WHEN term.fulfilled_flag = 1 THEN 'FULFILLED' WHEN term.deadline_date < DATE(#{now}) THEN 'OVERDUE' ELSE 'PENDING' END AS status

milestone.id, milestone.milestone_no, milestone.milestone_name, milestone.milestone_type, milestone.planned_date, milestone.actual_date, CAST(milestone.amount AS CHAR) AS amount, contract.currency, CASE WHEN milestone.status IN ('PENDING', 'IN_PROGRESS', 'DONE', 'OVERDUE', 'CANCELLED') THEN milestone.status ELSE 'UNKNOWN' END AS status

schedule.id, schedule.payment_no, schedule.payment_name, schedule.plan_date, schedule.actual_date, CAST(schedule.amount AS CHAR) AS amount, CAST(schedule.actual_amount AS CHAR) AS actual_amount, schedule.currency, CASE WHEN schedule.status IN ('PENDING', 'PAID', 'OVERDUE', 'CANCELLED') THEN schedule.status ELSE 'UNKNOWN' END AS status
mapper.select:
SELECT FROM oa_contract contract WHERE
AND (contract.contract_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR contract.contract_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
ORDER BY contract.contract_id DESC
SELECT FROM oa_contract contract WHERE AND contract.contract_id = #{contractId}

SELECT FROM oa_contract_fulfilment_term term JOIN oa_contract contract ON contract.tenant_id = term.tenant_id AND contract.contract_id = term.contract_id WHERE AND contract.contract_id = #{contractId} AND term.deleted = 0 AND JSON_TYPE(contract.portal_term_ids) = 'ARRAY' AND JSON_CONTAINS(contract.portal_term_ids, JSON_ARRAY(term.term_id)) = 1 ORDER BY term.sort_no, term.term_no, term.term_id

SELECT FROM oa_contract_milestone milestone JOIN oa_contract contract ON contract.tenant_id = milestone.tenant_id AND contract.contract_id = milestone.contract_id WHERE AND contract.contract_id = #{contractId} AND milestone.deleted = 0 AND JSON_TYPE(contract.portal_milestone_ids) = 'ARRAY' AND JSON_CONTAINS(contract.portal_milestone_ids, JSON_ARRAY(milestone.id)) = 1 ORDER BY milestone.milestone_no, milestone.id

SELECT FROM oa_contract_payment_schedule schedule JOIN oa_contract contract ON contract.tenant_id = schedule.tenant_id AND contract.contract_id = schedule.contract_id WHERE AND contract.contract_id = #{contractId} AND schedule.deleted = 0 AND JSON_TYPE(contract.portal_payment_schedule_ids) = 'ARRAY' AND JSON_CONTAINS(contract.portal_payment_schedule_ids, JSON_ARRAY(schedule.id)) = 1 ORDER BY schedule.payment_no, schedule.id
